prd.title: Operator Dashboard
prd.overview: The Operator Dashboard is Priya's landing page after login. It collapses the previous three-layout toggle (Overview / Sensors / Wards) into a single status-board grid showing ranked incidents. Each row renders BandPill (glyph + text) and reporter-badge chip as independent dimensions. Sort is priority-first / age-second. The hotline-intake trigger lives in the top-chrome action bar (mounted via WO-002). This is the load-bearing surface for Goal 1.1 (incident enters queue < 10s) and Goal 2.2 (status visible across personas).

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/OperatorDashboard.tsx (1,362 LOC) to spec lockdown; remove A/B/C toggle; mount HotlineIntakeModal trigger; emit IncidentDismissed on quick-dismiss

requirement.title: Status-board grid only (no A/B/C toggle)
requirement.description: Remove the three-layout (Overview / Sensors / Wards) toggle. Page renders only the status-board grid. Sensor/ward widgets deferred to dedicated routes (Phase 1.7+).

acceptance.criterion: No layout toggle control in DOM
Single status-board grid renders for /dashboard
Removed code is not re-rendered via any fallback

requirement.title: Priority-first / age-second sort (locked)
requirement.description: Sort incidents: priority P1 > P2 > P3 > P4, then ascending age. Same contract as FieldQueue (WO-006). Sort applied at render time (no re-fetch).

acceptance.criterion: P1 row appears above P2 row at same age
Within same priority, older row appears first

requirement.title: Trust-band glyph + text pattern
requirement.description: Each row renders BandPill with glyph + text: ◔ T1 / ◑ T2 / ● T3 / ✓ resolved. Per foundation §4.1; lockdown-binding; never color-only.

acceptance.criterion: Glyph + text rendered for each band state
Color alone never used to convey band (verified by DOM inspection)

requirement.title: Reporter-badge chip per row (independent dimension)
requirement.description: Each row renders reporter-badge chip: ⚓ anchor / ☎ hotline / ✎ webform / 📡 sensor. Independent of trust band; never collapses into it. Per foundation §6.2.

acceptance.criterion: Each row has reporter-badge chip with correct icon per reporter_kind
Trust band and reporter badge render as two separate DOM chips

requirement.title: Mount hotline-intake trigger in top-chrome action bar
requirement.description: Mount `+ New hotline report` button in top-chrome action bar (leftmost position). Click opens HotlineIntakeModal (WO-002). Phone icon (lucide 16px). Button variant: secondary (slate outline).

acceptance.criterion: Button visible on /dashboard for utility_operator
Click opens HotlineIntakeModal with focus trap
Button is leftmost in action bar (verified by tab order)

requirement.title: Filter chips (needs me / in flight)
requirement.description: Render two filter chips: "needs me" (default active) and "in flight". Click toggles active state. Filter applied at render time; chip state ephemeral (URL persistence deferred to Phase 1.7+).

acceptance.criterion: Both chips render in top-chrome
Default = "needs me"; click on "in flight" toggles
Filtered rows match chip intent

requirement.title: Auto-routed-tail chip (collapsed, top-right)
requirement.description: Render auto-routed-tail chip top-right showing count + "system handled, hide" affordance. Collapsed by default. Click expands to show 1-line summary per auto-routed incident.

acceptance.criterion: Chip renders collapsed with count
"Hide" affordance collapses chip
Expand shows 1-line summary per auto-routed incident

requirement.title: Quick-dismiss affordance on low-band rows
requirement.description: Render quick-dismiss button on T1/T2 rows. Click emits POST /api/events with IncidentDismissed{actor, incident_id, reason}. Confirmation not required (low-band, low-risk).

acceptance.criterion: Quick-dismiss button visible on T1/T2 rows; not on T3/resolved
Click emits IncidentDismissed event with correct payload

requirement.title: Focus rings use --color-primary-tint
requirement.description: Replace brand-400 focus rings with --color-primary-tint per foundation §10.2. Applies to all interactive elements on this page.

acceptance.criterion: Computed style of focused element resolves --color-primary-tint
No element uses var(--brand-400) for focus ring

requirement.title: Tab order matches visual order (foundation §10.3)
requirement.description: Tab order matches visual order: hotline trigger → filter chips → auto-routed chip → first row → ... → last row. Help (?) key opens help modal.

acceptance.criterion: Tab order assertion test passes
? key opens help modal (foundation §10.3)

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Mount /dashboard as utility_operator; assert no layout toggle; assert single grid renders. Status-board only.
Seed incidents with mixed priorities and ages; assert rendered order matches priority-first / age-second. Sort correct.
Render with each band; assert glyph + text present; assert no element conveys band via color alone. Glyph + text pattern enforced.
Click Log hotline call; assert modal opens with focus trap. Modal opens via trigger.
Click quick-dismiss on T1 row; intercept POST /api/events; assert IncidentDismissed with correct payload. Event fires correctly.
